title: 纳德拉就任 CEO 的第一封全员邮件（2014）
topic: 纳德拉就任 CEO 的第一封全员邮件（2014）

source.title: Satya Nadella email to employees on first day as CEO - Source
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: I am here for the same reason I think most people join Microsoft — to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things. I know it can sound hyperbolic — and yet it’s true. We have done it, we’re doing it today, and we are the team that will do it again.
Our job is to ensure that Microsoft thrives in a mobile and cloud-first world.

As we look forward, we must zero in on what Microsoft can uniquely contribute to the world. The opportunity ahead will require us to reimagine a lot of what we have done in the past for a mobile and cloud-first world, and do new things.

Qi Lu captured it well in a recent meeting when he said that Microsoft uniquely empowers people to “do more.” This doesn’t mean that we need to do more things, but that the work we do empowers the world to do more of what they care about — get stuff done, have fun, communicate and accomplish great things. This is the core of who we are, and driving this core value in all that we do — be it the cloud or device experiences — is why we are here.
translations: 我来到微软，和大多数加入微软的人一样，是希望通过技术改变世界，让技术帮助人们做出令人惊叹的事。
我们的工作是确保微软能在移动和云优先的世界中蓬勃发展。
展望未来，我们必须聚焦微软能为世界带来的独特贡献。未来的机会要求我们为移动和云优先的世界重新思考许多过去的做法，并开展新的工作。
Qi Lu 在一次会议上很好地概括了这一点：微软独特地赋能人们“做更多”。这不是说要做更多事情，而是我们的工作能让世界更好地去做他们关心的事——完成工作、享受生活、交流并取得成就。
fullTextParagraphs: From: Satya Nadella To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: RE: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is a very humbling day for me. It reminds me of my very first day at Microsoft, 22 years ago. Like you, I had a choice about where to come to work. I came here because I believed Microsoft was the best company in the world. I saw then how clearly we empower people to do magical things with our creations and ultimately make the world a better place. I knew there was no better company to join if I wanted to make a difference. This is the very same inspiration that continues to drive me today.

It is an incredible honor for me to lead and serve this great company of ours. Steve and Bill have taken it from an idea to one of the greatest and most universally admired companies in the world. I’ve been fortunate to work closely with both Bill and Steve in my different roles at Microsoft, and as I step in as CEO, I’ve asked Bill to devote additional time to the company, focused on technology and products. I’m also looking forward to working with John Thompson as our new Chairman of the Board.

While we have seen great success, we are hungry to do more. Our industry does not respect tradition — it only respects innovation. This is a critical time for the industry and for Microsoft. Make no mistake, we are headed for greater places — as technology evolves and we evolve with and ahead of it. Our job is to ensure that Microsoft thrives in a mobile and cloud-first world.
As we start a new phase of our journey together, I wanted to share some background on myself and what inspires and motivates me.

I am 46. I’ve been married for 22 years and we have 3 kids. And like anyone else, a lot of what I do and how I think has been shaped by my family and my overall life experiences. Many who know me say I am also defined by my curiosity and thirst for learning. I buy more books than I can finish. I sign up for more online courses than I can complete. I fundamentally believe that if you are not learning new things, you stop doing great and useful things. So family, curiosity and hunger for knowledge all define me.

I am here for the same reason I think most people join Microsoft — to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things. I know it can sound hyperbolic — and yet it’s true. We have done it, we’re doing it today, and we are the team that will do it again.

I believe over the next decade computing will become even more ubiquitous and intelligence will become ambient. The coevolution of software and new hardware form factors will intermediate and digitize — many of the things we do and experience in business, life and our world. This will be made possible by an ever-growing network of connected devices, incredible computing capacity from the cloud, insights from big data, and intelligence from machine learning.

It will better connect us to our friends and families and help us see, express, and share our world in ways never before possible. It will enable businesses to engage customers in more meaningful ways.
I am here because we have unparalleled capability to make an impact.

In our early history, our mission was about the PC on every desk and home, a goal we have mostly achieved in the developed world. Today we’re focused on a broader range of devices. While the deal is not yet complete, we will welcome to our family Nokia devices and services and the new mobile capabilities they bring us.

As we look forward, we must zero in on what Microsoft can uniquely contribute to the world. The opportunity ahead will require us to reimagine a lot of what we have done in the past for a mobile and cloud-first world, and do new things.

We are the only ones who can harness the power of software and deliver it through devices and services that truly empower every individual and every organization. We are the only company with history and continued focus in building platforms and ecosystems that create broad opportunity.

Qi Lu captured it well in a recent meeting when he said that Microsoft uniquely empowers people to “do more.” This doesn’t mean that we need to do more things, but that the work we do empowers the world to do more of what they care about — get stuff done, have fun, communicate and accomplish great things. This is the core of who we are, and driving this core value in all that we do — be it the cloud or device experiences — is why we are here.
To paraphrase a quote from Oscar Wilde — we need to believe in the impossible and remove the improbable.

This starts with clarity of purpose and sense of mission that will lead us to imagine the impossible and deliver it. We need to prioritize innovation that is centered on our core value of empowering users and organizations to “do more.” We have picked a set of high-value activities as part of our One Microsoft strategy. And with every service and device launch going forward we need to bring more innovation to bear around these scenarios.

Finally, I truly believe that each of us must find meaning in our work. The best work happens when you know that it’s not just work, but something that will improve other people’s lives. This is the opportunity that drives each of us at this company.

Many companies aspire to change the world. But very few have all the elements required: talent, resources, and perseverance. Microsoft has proven that it has all three in abundance. And as the new CEO, I can’t ask for a better foundation.
Let’s build on this foundation together.
Satya

notes.phrase: change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things
notes.meaning: 通过技术改变世界，让技术帮助人们做出令人惊叹的事
notes.explain: 这是纳德拉在 2014 年这封邮件里的使命表达。不要把后来的微软使命句“empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more”冒充为这封邮件的原句。
notes.example: Our team is here to change the world through technology that helps teachers.

notes.phrase: Microsoft thrives in a mobile and cloud-first world
notes.meaning: 微软在移动和云优先的世界中蓬勃发展
notes.explain: 这是邮件在 2014 年提出的战略重点，原文是 mobile and cloud-first，不是后来常见的 mobile-first, cloud-first 句式。
notes.example: The email says Microsoft needs to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.

notes.phrase: zero in on what Microsoft can uniquely contribute to the world
notes.meaning: 聚焦微软能为世界带来的独特贡献
notes.explain: zero in on 表示把注意力集中到某个具体重点。
notes.example: We need to zero in on the customer problem we can uniquely solve.

notes.phrase: we need to do more things
notes.explain: 原文明确说“做更多”不是增加任务数量，而是让人们更好地完成他们关心的事。
notes.example: The point is not to add more work, but to help customers do more of what they care about.

scenario.title: Summarize the message as it was written in 2014
english: A new colleague asks what Satya Nadella told Microsoft employees in his first email as CEO on February 4, 2014.
Summarize the purpose he described and the strategic environment he said Microsoft needed to address.
Use the 2014 email wording; do not substitute a mission statement introduced in a later period.
chinese: 一位新同事问，萨提亚·纳德拉在 2014 年 2 月 4 日就任 CEO 后的首封邮件里对微软员工说了什么。
概括他表达的使命和当时指出的战略环境。
请按 2014 年邮件原文概括，不要用之后时期提出的使命句替代。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新同事问纳德拉在 2014 年就任微软 CEO 的首封员工邮件中提出了什么使命和战略重点。请用两句英文概括原文。
firstAttempt.sample: Nadella said Microsoft was here to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things. He said the company needed to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.
firstAttempt.rationale: 两句分别概括邮件中的使命表达和 2014 年战略重点，保留原文 mobile and cloud-first 的说法，不额外加入后来的使命口号。

words.collocation: clarity of purpose and sense of mission
words.example: The email explains what inspires the company and why it exists.
words.translation: 这封邮件说明了什么激励着公司，以及公司的存在目的。
words.note: 商务语境中指组织想实现的核心目标。

words.example: The product empowers teachers to share learning materials.
words.translation: 这款产品帮助教师分享学习材料。
words.note: 常接人或组织，再接 to do，说明赋予对方什么能力。

words.example: The service needs to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.
words.translation: 这项服务需要在移动和云优先的世界中蓬勃发展。
words.note: 比 survive 更强调发展良好。

words.example: The email says the industry respects innovation.
words.translation: 邮件指出，行业尊重创新。
words.note: 不要把它缩窄为追求新奇；本信谈的是推动行业和产品发展。

words.example: The team wants to contribute to a more accessible learning experience.
words.translation: 团队希望为更易获取的学习体验作出贡献。
words.note: contribute to 后接贡献对象或领域。

words.example: The 2014 email describes a mobile and cloud-first world.
words.translation: 2014 年的邮件描述了一个移动和云优先的世界。
words.note: 按当时邮件原文保留 mobile and cloud-first 的说法。

structure.original: Our job is to ensure that Microsoft thrives in a mobile and cloud-first world.
analysis: 主句主语是 Our job，谓语是 is，后面的不定式 to ensure 说明这项工作的目标。
ensure 后接 that 引导的宾语从句；从句主语是 Microsoft，谓语是 thrives。
in a mobile and cloud-first world 说明微软需要蓬勃发展的技术环境；这是 2014 年邮件中的表述。
structure.transfer: Our team needs to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first environment while helping teachers use learning tools across devices.

rewrite.bad: The mission is to sell more software. The strategy can wait.
rewrite.good: Nadella said Microsoft was here to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things. He said the company needed to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.
rewrite.translation: 纳德拉表示，微软希望通过能帮助人们做出惊人之事的技术改变世界；公司需要在移动和云优先的世界中蓬勃发展。
rewrite.pattern: Nadella said [organization] was here to [purpose]. He said it needed to thrive in [strategic environment].

cloze.why: change the world through technology 概括邮件中的使命表达。

cloze.prompt: He described technology that empowers people to do ___ things.
cloze.why: 保留原文的 amazing things，不换成后来使命表述中的 achieve more。

cloze.prompt: Microsoft needed to ___ in a mobile and cloud-first world.
cloze.why: thrive in 描述在某种环境中蓬勃发展。

apply.prompt: 用你所在团队的真实目标替换 Microsoft 和 mobile and cloud-first world。
apply.sample: Our team is here to help teachers do more through technology. We need to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first environment.

translationPractice.prompt: 纳德拉写道，微软希望通过技术改变世界。
translationPractice.answer: Nadella wrote that Microsoft was here to change the world through technology.
translationPractice.why: change the world through technology 对应邮件中的目的表达。

translationPractice.prompt: 他描述了能帮助人们做出令人惊叹之事的技术。
translationPractice.answer: He described technology that empowers people to do amazing things.
translationPractice.why: technology that empowers people to do amazing things 对应邮件原文。

translationPractice.prompt: 他表示，微软需要在移动和云优先的世界中蓬勃发展。
translationPractice.answer: He said Microsoft needed to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.
translationPractice.why: 保留 2014 年邮件中的 mobile and cloud-first。

choice.prompt: 以下哪一项最准确地概括了这封 2014 年邮件？
options: The company mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and its strategy is mobile-first and cloud-first.
Nadella said Microsoft wanted to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things, and needed to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.
The email focuses mainly on quarterly budgets, marketing campaigns, and an immediate reorganization.
choice.why: B 对应邮件原文的使命和当时战略表述。A 使用了后来时期的使命公式和另一种短语形式，不能冒充 2014 邮件原话。

output.prompt: 迁移情境：新人介绍会上，你需要用三句英文介绍一个为教师开发移动学习工具的团队。说明团队想通过技术带来什么改变、希望赋能谁实现什么，以及产品应适应怎样的技术环境。请用你们团队自己的情况，不要照搬微软使命口号。
output.sample: Our team is here to make learning easier through technology. We want to empower teachers and students to do amazing things. Our product needs to thrive in a mobile and cloud-first world.
check: 是否说明团队希望带来的改变？
是否说清希望帮助谁实现什么？
是否说明产品所处的技术环境？
是否使用本团队事实而非把微软语句说成自己的使命？
